end_chip.basis: R2: median over vendor groups of each group's median plunge chip per tooth h_p/D (stated plunge fz, or the vendor's plunge/drilling factor × its slot fz), per diameter band, ≥ 2 groups (neighbouring bands pooled when fewer)

ramp_end_chip_reported.basis: vendor ramp chip × sin(maximum ramp angle) ('stated' and 'rule' rows); reported, not a constraint

consensus.basis: Vendor ramp consensus (user rule 2026-10-17 as C14): ramp angle ≤ consensus_scale(a) × the median over ≥ 2 independent vendor groups of their (maximum) ramp angle, widened stepwise (diameter band, hardness, family-wide); plunge feed ≤ scale × median plunge/slot feed factor × the ramp (slot-like) feed
